content: Job posting duplication is severe: average ad reposted 2-5x, 50-80% of aggregator listings are duplicates. Near-duplicates are rarely identical (text restructured per site). Industry approaches: Lightcast normalizes title+company+location and checks across 60 days of data; Textkernel uses shingling/minhash; Indeed consolidates similar titles/locations per company. Exact-URL or exact-text dedupe fails; need normalized composite keys plus fuzzy matching, and repost handling (same job re-opened).
